notes.note: Ash had his best of the season when it mattered for us most with his 11 marks and 36 disposals.
20 touches for Ash and with that we saw his second lowest score since their bye and third lowest of the season. Conditions were tough and didn't suit him.
Ash was floating across half back and managed 25 touches and 5 marks. Not a dominant game from him but he left that to Whitfield this week.
Ash took 8 marks and was one of 5 Giants over 100 with his 26 touches. Still a solid contributor to your back line.
Despite having some CBAs we saw Ash finish with 23 disposals with 5 tackles. He had 6 clangers which was the equal most for the Giants.
Ash had 30 disposals and took 9 marks in a solid performance where he didn't have Whitfield to take some of the defensive responsibility.
Ash had the main role off half back when Whitfield exited the game with 28 disposals at 82%. He will be relied on more as Whitfield will miss next week.
Ash rolled an ankle but stayed out on the ground and was fine after that finishing with 24 disposals and a goal. Hopefully it didn't flare up when it cooled down and he is right to go this week.
Ash top scored for the Giants with 8 marks and 26 disposals as he has that friendly half back role that sees him pick up some quality possessions.
Ash was targeted by plenty of teams off his bye and he delivered with the top score for the Giants. He is yet to go under 90 since round 7. Many will bring him in for Roberts.

Ash took 11 marks to go with his 34 disposals. He has had some good scoring of late although this is just the second over 100 in the last 7. The others have been serviceable but not the ceiling scores we hoped.
Ash has scored over 90 in his last 5 games but only once he has gotten past the 100 mark.
Ash compiled 34 disposals at 67%. He hasn't been under the 90 mark for the last 4 games now.
Ash had the second most points for the Giants thanks to 9 marks and 23 disposals at 82%. He is one that we have had our eye on and this broke a run of three in a row under 100.

Ash dropped in his price as he didn't get to his big BE. It was his third below 100 in a row this week but it is two in the 90s in the last two. His BE at 122 means you can wait on him to bring him in.
30 disposals for Ash and while it was below 100 it wasn't by much. His BE has risen and as a result he will get cheaper. Be patient and we can get him cheap.
29 touches for Ash with 8 marks but just 4 contested and 1 clearance which led to his first under 100 since opening round. It was a tight game so don't worry about him.
Ash managed 35 disposals and 4 marks. This is four over 100 now in a row and it is making him a must have down back.
Ash is again putting up his hand as one of the players we must consider. He put out 28 disposals at 85% and took 10 marks and he did this with Whitfield having a big game too which is a great sign.
Ash has now posted back to back good scores and is showing that he is again one that we need to have in our sights for an upgrade during the year. 39 disposals and 9 marks.
Ash is off to a flyer with a great game in the big loss as the ball did spend a lot of time down his end.
